checks.evidence: Provider failure is retained as a platform error carrying the exact DAG node id, controlled provider id, code and retryability.
A cyclic two-node plan is rejected before any provider operation is called.
A source output attested with a scalar schema/kind is rejected before it can bind to a position input.
Aggregate node row, candidate, byte and execution budgets are validated against both the plan and Gateway policy before execution.
ALLOW_PARTIAL retains the failed node and its warning while returning the independently completed node; unavailable output is never fabricated.

Input/output hashes and terminal node records survive construction of a new runtime over the same store. PostgreSQL tables, atomic claim, transition ledger and least-privilege grants parse successfully, but a real PostgreSQL restart run is NOT_RUN because current database credentials and Docker escalation are unavailable.
The runtime and HTTP routes cover synchronous execution, respond-async submission, lookup, cancellation and unified job lookup.

World Query v2 builds a strict nested operation request from canonical typed leaves. Whole-request, precondition, and output target paths; duplicate and ancestor paths; unsafe prototype segments; and depth over eight are rejected before provider execution.

The P12 runtime suite passed 12 tests, including schema-validated nested targetPath construction, leaf and assembled-request validation, fail-closed target-path cases, canonical request-envelope construction from typed field/output-path bindings, and an explicit typed value-equality precondition. A fresh aggregate platform run passed 6 files and 47 tests.
npm.cmd run check and npm.cmd run validate:boundaries passed.
pgsql-parser parsed migration 013 as 19 statements and database assertion 005 as one statement after removing the psql meta-command.
The reachable isolated PostgreSQL endpoint requires credentials unavailable to this phase; new Docker execution requires escalation while the current approval quota is unavailable.
The sandbox cannot create .git/index.lock and the escalation request is unavailable under the current usage limit.
